reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Airy Sun Stick 19g
reviews.text: Bought this for my 12-year-old daughter! The stick format is incredibly convenient because she doesn't have to touch her face with dirty hands. It has a slight scent in the tube, but it’s completely unnoticeable once applied. It didn't clog her pores, caused no irritation, and feels very comfortable even in hot weather. The sun protection is great. The only downside is that it runs out way too quickly.
reviews.zh: 買俾我 12 歲嘅女用！筆狀設計超方便，佢唔使再用污糟污糟嘅手掂塊面。支入面有少少味道，但搽上面就完全聞唔到。唔會塞毛孔，無刺激，熱天用都好舒服。防曬效果一流。唯一缺點就係用得太快。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Airy Sun Stick 19g
reviews.text: I really like this sun stick! My skin breaks out easily, but this one doesn’t cause any issues. It feels light, easy to apply, and works great for sensitive skin.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢枝防曬棒！我皮膚容易爆瘡，但呢枝完全冇問題。質地輕盈，容易搽，對敏感肌超好用。
